title: Joomla 2.5 component to Joomla 5 plugin: skip the rewrite
lede: An old Joomla 2.5 component still runs the client's catalogue. PHP 8.2 is coming. Here's how to lift it onto Joomla 5 as a plugin without touching the schema.
hero_alt: Two layered paper sheets labeled Joomla 2.5 Component and Joomla 5 Plugin, brass tacks, ruler, pencil, red wax seal.
